title: Agent Kernel v0 (deterministic run harness)
repo_context: Library-first kernel with deterministic state machine, policy interface, and run artifacts. Parallel to existing feature-graph and retrieval systems.

stories.title: Create kernel request/result and core enums
acceptance_criteria: KernelRequest, KernelResult, TerminalOutcome, StopReason, KernelState, and ActionType (including SET_GRAPH_REQUIREMENTS) models exist under `backend/agent_kernel/`.
KernelRequest includes goal.requires_global_placement and round-trips in tests.
`pytest backend/agent_kernel/test_models.py` passes with JSON round-trip coverage.
stories.notes: Budgets and goal flags are required fields.

stories.title: Add RunArtifact + StepRecord models with refs
acceptance_criteria: RunArtifact stores refs to IR/compile/judge/bundle/retrieval artifacts (no blobs).
StepRecord captures action, inputs, outputs, and reason codes.
StepRecord supports a small inline validation_result (or outputs_inline) for deterministic validation outputs; tests assert it does not carry large geometry blobs.
`pytest backend/agent_kernel/test_run_artifact.py` passes.
stories.notes: Evidence refs should be path + card/span indices.

stories.title: Define kernel state machine transitions
acceptance_criteria: Kernel state machine covers INIT, HAVE_IR, HAVE_COMPILE, HAVE_JUDGE, REPAIRING, READY_TO_MAP, MAPPED, DONE.
Transitions are explicit and deterministic.
`pytest backend/agent_kernel/test_state_machine.py` passes.

stories.title: Add policy interface + default FeatureGraphDeedToMapPolicy v0 scaffold
acceptance_criteria: Policy interface includes routing order hooks and gap scoring hooks.
Default policy class exists in `backend/agent_kernel/policies/feature_graph_deed_to_map_v0.py`.
`pytest backend/agent_kernel/test_policy_scaffold.py` passes.
stories.notes: Keep domain logic out of kernel mechanics.

stories.title: Implement budget enforcement helpers
acceptance_criteria: Budget tracking for steps, wall time, retrieval calls, semantic calls, and patch calls exists.
Over-budget results in StopReason budget_exceeded.
`pytest backend/agent_kernel/test_budgets.py` passes.
stories.notes: Kernel enforces semantic budget by limiting semantic-lane retrieval calls.

stories.title: Add no-progress detection and gap scoring
acceptance_criteria: Kernel computes gap_signature and artifact digests per iteration.
No-progress triggers StopReason no_progress after N repair cycles.
`pytest backend/agent_kernel/test_no_progress.py` passes.

stories.title: Implement deterministic action executor scaffold
acceptance_criteria: Action executor supports deterministic actions: SET_GRAPH_REQUIREMENTS, RETRIEVE_EVIDENCE, COMPILE, JUDGE, BUNDLE, GEOREFERENCE, VALIDATE.
SET_GRAPH_REQUIREMENTS updates graph.metadata.global_placement_required and records the updated IR ref in StepRecord outputs.
VALIDATE returns validation_result inline in StepRecord (no new validation artifact store).
LLM actions are stubbed with explicit interfaces (PROPOSE_PATCH, SUMMARIZE_STATUS).
`pytest backend/agent_kernel/test_actions.py` passes.
stories.notes: Actions should record reason codes on failure.

stories.title: Add run artifact persistence service
acceptance_criteria: RunArtifactPersistenceService writes artifacts atomically and maintains an index.
Artifacts are stored under a new agent-kernel root in config paths.
`pytest backend/agent_kernel/test_persistence.py` passes using temp roots.

stories.title: Implement kernel loop core (library entrypoint)
acceptance_criteria: Kernel loop can run from a KernelRequest and emit KernelResult + RunArtifact.
When requires_global_placement=true, SET_GRAPH_REQUIREMENTS runs early before judge/compile so anchor gaps can surface deterministically.
Deterministic stop reasons are set for budget_exceeded and no_progress paths.
`pytest backend/agent_kernel/test_kernel_loop.py` passes.

stories.title: Add minimal CLI for deterministic kernel runs
acceptance_criteria: CLI accepts a JSON request file and prints a JSON KernelResult.
`pytest backend/agent_kernel/test_cli.py` passes.
stories.notes: Keep CLI minimal; no external dependencies.
